fact: The Ghana Statistical Service's census page gives the 2021 Population and Housing Census as the latest national census and projects the next for 2030, with planning under way.
The Ghana Statistical Service's census page offers the 2021 Population and Housing Census reports, regional and district profiles and population structure indicators.
The World Bank's WDI lists the Demographic and Health Survey 2022 as Ghana's latest demographic, education or health household survey.
The World Bank's WDI lists a Living Standards Measurement Study survey (LSMS) of 2017 as the source of Ghana's most recent income and expenditure data.
